text:
aditya: heads-up — during onboarding I hit repeated 429s calling /v1/embeddings from the node SDK. retries are re-sending the same request and we ended up with duplicate rows in our ingestion DB. anyone else seeing this?

maya: which node sdk version? v0.9.x had different retry behavior than v0.10. :thinking_face:

sam: can you paste a minimal log? embeddings should be idempotent but our dedupe relies on client-provided id; if that's missing we'll see dupes.

aditya: log excerpt: ```WARN Request failed 429 rate_limit_exceeded
WARN retrying attempt=1 payload_hash=abc123
WARN Request failed 429 rate_limit_exceeded
WARN retrying attempt=2 payload_hash=abc123
INFO response id=resp_xyz status=200```

jess: we've seen this with python too — SDK backoff was exponential without jitter so clients bunch up, then retries re-send identical payloads. also token refresh flow can cause a replay if the original attempt isn't marked as "in-flight" vs "aborted".

aditya: workaround for us was adding a client header `x-client-dedup` with a UUID per logical request and deduping server-side. not great for customers to require that though.

maya: can the SDK set a default idempotency header for embeddings? API doesn't currently accept a formal idempotency-key header for embeddings requests.

sam: proposal: SDK should (1) expose an explicit `idempotencyKey` option, (2) emit a `x-redwood-client-id` header automatically when provided, and (3) use jittered exponential backoff with a small random offset between 0..100ms. also provide a `maxRetries` config that's explicit.

jess: I'll open a PR that: adds jitter util to retry-utils, wires it into Node + Python parity layers, and exposes `retryHook` for custom behavior. will include tests that simulate 429 + flaky auth refresh.

aditya: sample SDK constructor snippet for docs: ```js
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  maxRetries: 1, // default preserved for compat
  idempotencyKey: () => uuidv4(), // optional per logical request
  retryOptions: { base: 200, cap: 2000, jitter: true }
})
```

maya: small note: some Dedicated customers rely on previous zero-retry semantics; keep default at 0 or 1? We changed default earlier and that caused surprises.

sam: keep default at 0 for strict parity, but set recommended default in docs to 1 with jitter for most customers. mention Dedicated caveat.

jess: PR will keep constructor default unchanged, but add `recommendedConfig` snippet in README and migration note. I'll add a short sample app in /examples/embedding-dedupe that demos `x-client-dedup` + server-side dedupe.

aditya: perfect. can someone add a tiny onboarding note to the docs: "Embeddings + retries: avoid client-side duplicates by adding idempotency or server dedupe" so CS folks can point customers there.

ci-bot: CI: build/3421 — retry-utils-test failed on flakey timing in Windows matrix; rerunning build...

maya: thanks — I'll follow up with the test timeout fix (use looser time bounds + fake timers).

aditya: awesome. thanks team :zap: If you want, I can paste our minimal repro app to the PR — it shows 429 -> duplicated DB insert without dedupe header.

sam: yes please. small, focused repro will speed review.

jess: adding it now. will tag you for review. :thumbsup:
